assets/environments/cubemaps.notes: Standard cubemap assets installed with the CMake Assets component and the Python package.

assets/models/psm.notes: Standard model assets installed with the CMake Assets component and the Python package. Imported from SurRoL and locally modified; upstream AMBF/WPI-AIM/dVRK provenance is retained in README.md. AMBF's current default branch has no repository-wide license file, so this notice relies on SurRoL's explicit MIT license.

extern/CRESSim-Ultrasound.notes: Included in the maximum-inclusion notice. This submodule's BSD-3-Clause license and its retained OpenBCSim and PhysX notices are distributed when its source is included; CUDA runtime components remain user-provided and are not shipped.

extern/DiligentEngine.notes: DiligentCore and DiligentTools TextureLoader are compiled into the shipped libraries; DiligentTools generally is disabled. The SDK installs the DiligentCore headers required by CRESSim's current public API, but excludes DiligentCore/ThirdParty. The Diligent module license files are byte-identical; use the one canonical Apache-2.0 text. Bundled third-party dependencies are reviewed as separate components.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentCore/Third.notes: Fetched by Diligent's CMake configuration, but not compiled, linked, copied as headers, or present in the CXXSDK install manifest for the configured Linux release build. Revisit if a future configuration links Abseil or installs its source/headers.

WebGPU is forcibly disabled. This checkout contains only a FetchContent recipe; the configured Linux release build has no Dawn source/build directory and no Dawn install-manifest entry. Diligent's dormant WebGPU headers are installed under Diligent's Apache-2.0 license, not as Dawn code. Revisit if WebGPU is enabled.
Vendored DXC headers are not part of the installed SDK. The separate bundled DXC runtime is tracked as a build-artifact component using its artifact-specific license files.

DirectXShaderCompiler (bundled artifact).notes: When CRESSIM_NEO_DXC_PROVIDER=BUNDLED, the pinned DirectXShaderCompiler release runtime is installed with CRESSim. Its notice files are read from the downloaded archive using the bundled-dxc entry in compliance/third_party_artifacts.json.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentCore/Third.notes: FSR shader headers are not part of the installed SDK, and the configured Linux release build does not compile Diligent SuperResolution. Revisit if a shipped configuration enables and links the FSR implementation.
OpenGL is disabled, no GLEW binary is built, and DiligentCore/ThirdParty headers are not part of the installed SDK. Revisit if a shipped configuration enables OpenGL/GLEW.
Vulkan is enabled and DILIGENT_NO_GLSLANG is not forced; glslang is built for shader compilation and linked into the shipped Diligent shader toolchain. Its vendored headers are not installed.
Diligent tests are disabled and DiligentCore/ThirdParty headers are not part of the installed SDK. No GoogleTest code or headers are shipped in the configured SDK.

Its checksum source is compiled by Diligent ShaderTools when a D3D backend is enabled. Its vendored header is not installed, but retain it in the single maximum-inclusion notice for shipped multi-platform builds.

OpenXR is not enabled. This checkout contains only a FetchContent recipe, and no fetched OpenXR SDK headers, binaries, or license files are present in the configured build or install manifest. The installed dormant Diligent OpenXR helper headers are Diligent code, not OpenXR-SDK code. Revisit if OpenXR is enabled.
Built by Diligent's active Vulkan/SPIR-V toolchain and linked into the shipped shader tooling. Its vendored headers are not installed.

scan_suggested_notice_sources.detected_license_expression: (Apache-2.0 OR MIT) AND Apache-2.0 AND MIT

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentCore/Third.notes: Vulkan is enabled, so Diligent uses SPIRV-Headers as an internal interface dependency for its SPIR-V toolchain. Its headers are not installed. The selected Khronos license section applies to the compiled header material; the JsonCpp build-tool and CC-BY documentation sections are not shipped or compiled.
Built for the active Vulkan shader toolchain and linked into the shipped Diligent libraries. Its vendored headers are not installed.

stb_image_write is used only by Diligent's GPU test framework, which is not built here. Its header is not part of the installed SDK. An upstream-installed license file alone does not make the code a shipped component.
Vulkan is enabled, and volk is built and linked by the Diligent Vulkan GPU target. Its vendored header is not installed.

Vulkan is enabled and Diligent uses this header-only interface dependency internally to compile its Vulkan backend. Its vendored headers are not installed. This is distinct from the system Vulkan loader/runtime, which CRESSim does not bundle. Apache-2.0 is a valid license choice for the code used here; LICENSE.md identifies the file licensing and the selected Apache text provides the complete license.

The BSD-2-Clause xxHash library is linked by Diligent GraphicsTools. The installed SDK does not contain the unrelated GPL-2.0-or-later xxhsum CLI or test headers. The BSD xxHash LICENSE is sufficient.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentSamples/Th.notes: DiligentSamples is disabled and this vendored GLFW copy is not part of CRESSim's build or installed SDK. CRESSim uses the independently pinned extern/glfw dependency instead.

extern/glfw.notes: GLFW 3.4 is pinned as an independent source submodule. CRESSim's viewer compiles it as a static library and links it privately into the installed cressim_neo_viewer library. MinGW is unsupported, so GLFW's vendored LGPL fallback headers are never used.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentSamples/Th.notes: DiligentSamples is disabled, and no active CRESSim target or SDK install rule references this vendored Nuklear copy.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentTools/Thir.notes: args is used only by disabled Diligent command-line tools such as RenderStatePackager and HLSL2GLSLConverter. No active CRESSim target includes or installs args.hxx. An installed license file alone does not make the dependency part of the shipped product.
imgui is used only by DiligentSamples and disabled Diligent ImGui/tool targets. No active CRESSim target builds, links, or installs this vendored copy.
This directory contains macOS compatibility files used only by the disabled Diligent-Imgui target. No active CRESSim target builds, links, or installs them.

imGuIZMO.quat is compiled only by the disabled Diligent-Imgui target and DiligentSamples. No active CRESSim target builds, links, or installs it. An installed license file alone does not make the dependency part of the shipped product.

CRESSim configures the Diligent-JSON interface target only as part of the ThirdParty directory needed for TextureLoader. TextureLoader does not consume it. Its consumers are Diligent RenderStateNotation and tests, neither of which is added, built, linked, or installed by CRESSim.
Built by the manually added DiligentTools ThirdParty tree and linked into the TextureLoader used by cressim_neo_graphics. README contains the upstream IJG license terms.
Built and linked into the TextureLoader used by cressim_neo_graphics. The main project license is the relevant canonical notice for the built library.
Built and linked into the TextureLoader used by cressim_neo_graphics. COPYRIGHT is the upstream canonical notice file.
TextureLoader directly compiles stb_image and stb_dxt into the library used by cressim_neo_graphics.

tinygltf is used by Diligent AssetLoader, DiligentFX, and tests. CRESSim adds only DiligentTools ThirdParty and TextureLoader; it does not add, build, link, or install those consumers or tinygltf headers.
Built and linked into the TextureLoader used by cressim_neo_graphics. The main zlib license is the relevant canonical notice for the built library.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentCore/Third.notes: This directory orchestrates independently reviewed DiligentCore dependencies. It has no distinct third-party code or license to distribute as a separate component; the individual dependency entries govern the notice decisions.

extern/DiligentEngine/DiligentTools/Thir.notes: This directory configures independently reviewed DiligentTools dependencies. CRESSim keeps DILIGENT_INSTALL_TOOLS off, and the active TextureLoader dependencies have individual review entries; the parent directory has no separate component notice.

project files with third-party clues.notes: This catch-all contains project-owned configuration, metadata, and repository URLs, not a third-party component. Any bundled DirectXShaderCompiler artifact is reviewed separately when that distribution path is finalized.

extern/pybind11.notes: Pinned pybind11 v3.0.4 headers are compiled into the optional _cressim_neo Python extension through pybind11_add_module. The extension is installed with Python-enabled CRESSim packages.

assets/environments/skybox.notes: Six skybox JPEG assets are installed with the CRESSim package and shared assets. The supplied attribution identifies Emil Persson (Humus) and the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported license.
